subject: MAP timeline re-baseline request — mitigation & deputy ownership
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP and evaluation gating — ask on timeline flexibility

Mina — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Good momentum on the eval plan, but procurement surfaced a new security addendum that will require legal review and an extra SOC evidence package.

Quick reality check from our side: Legal/procurement estimate this adds ~10 business days before they can sign off; that pushes our planned go-live window out by roughly two weeks. We wanted to surface it early so we can align the MAP and avoid surprises with our execs.

As a couple of concrete asks:
- Can Redwood provide a short MAP addendum that re-states acceptance criteria with a shifted acceptance window?
- Can someone from your side be designated a deputy owner for the acceptance gate so our PM and procurement have a single point of contact for questions?
- If timelines slip, will Redwood accept a temporary change to the rollout cadence (phased acceptance) so we can start a limited pilot while the full contract clears?

We can be flexible on the exact dates but we need a written re-baseline and owner assignment by end of next week (20 Jun) to present to our committee.

Appreciate it —
Alex Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme Analytics

Attachments: procurement_addendum_template.pdf (sent by procurement)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP and evaluation gating — ask on timeline flexibility

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the addendum. We can support a short re-baseline and assign a deputy owner for the acceptance gate. High-level plan below and I'll follow up with the MAP addendum (tracked changes) and a lightweight risk log by tomorrow EOD.

Proposed mitigation / immediate asks:
- Re-baseline: shift acceptance window from 30 Jun -> 14 Jul (two-week shift). Will include a phased pilot window (pilot starts 7 Jul for a subset of traffic).
- Deputy owner: assigning Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com) as acceptance deputy for the MAP; procurement and your PM should use him as the escalation point.
- Evidence bundle: we will deliver the SOC extracts and log export samples within 4 business days; full SOC 2 package as per your procurement timeline.
- Temporary cadence change: agree to phased acceptance (pilot then full go-live) provided the MAP addendum is signed and we have the procurement acknowlegement by 20 Jun.

Attachments I'm including now: MAP_v2.xlsx (with updated dates and phased acceptance rows), risk_register_v1.csv (initial risks and owners). I also attached our draft response to the addendum (procurement_addendum-redwood-draft.pdf).

Next steps for us (internal):
- Jonas to confirm support for deputy role (jonas to reply-all).
- Karthik to validate that the pilot configuration keeps cost and latency in accepted bounds (estimate due 15 Jun).
- Marissa to prepare exec-facing change summary for Acme (due 18 Jun).

Alex — if those are acceptable, I will send a concise MAP addendum (one page) with the revised dates and owner roster by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx; risk_register_v1.csv; procurement_addendum-redwood-draft.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP timeline re-baseline request — mitigation plan and owner assignments

Team — forwarding Alex's note and my reply (below) to capture the mitigation plan and create a slim risk log we can operate against. This is the exact message that goes to the Acme stakeholders tomorrow, so I want internal confirmation on owners and deliverables.

Quoted original:
> Mina — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Good momentum on the eval plan, but procurement surfaced a new security addendum that will require legal review and an extra SOC evidence package.
> 
> Quick reality check from our side: Legal/procurement estimate this adds ~10 business days before they can sign off; that pushes our planned go-live window out by roughly two weeks.

Summary of agreed re-baseline (what we will commit internally):
- Acceptance window: 30 Jun -> 14 Jul (two-week shift).
- Pilot: limited pilot running 07 Jul–13 Jul for up to 5% traffic; full acceptance gated on evidence and final procurement sign-off.

Top risks and mitigation owners (from risk_register_v1.csv):
1) Procurement addendum causes >2w delay — mitigation: legal carve-out + draft response. Owner: Marissa Cole. Due: 18 Jun.
2) Evidence delivery lag (SOC samples) — mitigation: Jonas to provide log export samples within 4 business days; escalate to Mina if blocked. Owner: Jonas Weber. Due: 16 Jun.
3) Pilot performance spike — mitigation: Karthik to run a pre-pilot load run and provide config guardrails; postpone pilot start if tail latency > SLA. Owner: Karthik Iyer. Due: 15 Jun.
4) Executive sign-off drift — mitigation: one-page exec summary and decision window. Owner: Grace O'Connor. Due: 18 Jun.

Action items (please confirm by reply-all with "ack / will do / blocked"):
- Marissa: draft procurement response and exec summary (18 Jun).
- Jonas: accept deputy owner and confirm evidence extraction plan (16 Jun).
- Karthik: run pilot rehearsal and produce configuration checklist (15 Jun).
- Grace: draft the one-page decision summary for Acme execs (18 Jun).

I've attached the working MAP addendum (MAP_v2.xlsx) and the initial risk register. I'll incorporate your replies and send the client-facing addendum to Alex tomorrow morning. We need to get the deputy owner confirmation and the evidence ETA before we send.

Thanks —
Mina

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx; risk_register_v1.csv
